state.objective: Correct the proposed core COA using only account families that actually exist in the client's legacy COA, while removing unit duplication through cost center/site and subledgers.
state.hard_constraint: Do not introduce a natural-account family with no client legacy counterpart. Existing family names may be normalized for clarity, but their accounting nature must be traceable to the client COA.
state.organization: One PT Perorangan. HO and all stores are cost centers/sites within the same legal entity. Centralized Finance. No unit-to-unit independent legal transactions. Operational HO-to-unit funding and goods balances are reconciled internally.

software: Software including Seventh Soft Application and Opti Tex System
loans: PJP Jatuh Tempo Bank by bank
Pinjaman Jangka Panjang Bank by bank
land_and_rent: Biaya Sewa Bangunan Toko dan Gudang

state.confirmed_absence: No account family named Barang Diterima Belum Ditagih or GRNI exists in the client COA.
state.available_dimensions: cost_center/site_id, principal_id, facility_id, bank_account_id, loan_facility_id, maturity schedule, asset_id, asset_class_id, project_id, document_id and reason code.
owner_decisions: Retain one Pendapatan (Biaya) Lain-Lain family; unit is cost center.
Retain one Current Tax/PPh 25 family; unit is cost center.
Retain Harga Pokok Pembelian and Potongan Pembelian separately.
Delete Giro Keluar from future posting.
Compress Replacement OE item detail rather than retain one account per item.
Compress unit-specific Principal accounts using cost center.
feedback_to_test: Three affiliation control balances are required: financing, goods and other; financing and goods must not merge.
Software/intangible cost and accumulated amortization must return to core.
Harga Pokok Pembelian/HPP must return to core.
Bank loans and Principal loans should each be one core nature, with current/non-current financial-statement classification derived from maturity schedules.
One Principal payable/loan account replaces unit-specific Principal accounts if their substance is the same.
One income-tax expense family is needed for closing.

grni_remove.instructions: Should the invented GRNI account be removed because the client COA has no GRNI family?

criteria.yes: Do not introduce GRNI; preserve client semantics through the existing Supplier Merchandise Suspend/AP workflow if needed.
criteria.no: Add a new GRNI family despite the constraint.

supplier_suspend.instructions: Should Hutang Supplier Barang Dagang - Suspend remain distinct from posted merchandise AP?

criteria.yes: It is an existing client control family for suspended/unresolved merchandise liabilities or matching.
criteria.merge: Merge immediately into ordinary merchandise AP.

affiliation_three.instructions: Should the production design retain three distinct affiliation-control natures: Financing, Goods and Other?

criteria.yes: Their operational origin and reconciliation differ; cost center/site carries the unit.
criteria.two: Keep Financing and Goods only; map Other case-by-case.

affiliation_not_legal_arap.instructions: How should these affiliation accounts be understood when all units are one legal entity?

criteria.internal_control: Internal balancing/control accounts eliminated in entity-wide reporting, not external receivables/payables; cost center and source documents reconcile both sides.
criteria.external: Treat units as external legal counterparties.
criteria.intercompany: Treat each store as a separate company.

affiliation_pairing.instructions: Can one control account per affiliation nature carry debit and credit cost-center balances instead of separate Piutang and Hutang natural accounts?

criteria.one_per_nature: Yes, if reports classify/decompose debit and credit balances by cost center without improper entity-level netting.
criteria.two_per_nature: Keep separate debit and credit control accounts for each nature.
criteria.net_entity: Net everything at entity level without cost-center reconciliation.

software_cost.instructions: Should the existing Software cost family return to core?

criteria.yes: Intangible cost must exist because client has software assets and an amortization expense.

software_accum.instructions: Should Acc Amort Software return to core?

criteria.yes: Accumulated amortization is required separately from gross software cost and amortization expense.

software_detail.instructions: Where should Seventh Soft and Opti Tex identity reside?

criteria.register: In asset_id/intangible register, not separate natural accounts.
criteria.gl: One GL account per software product.

hpp_core.instructions: Should Harga Pokok Pembelian/HPP return to core?

criteria.yes: It is an actual client COGS/purchase-cost family and should reconcile to inventory costing.
criteria.no: Leave the client's main HPP family migration-only.

purchase_discount_separate.instructions: Should Potongan Pembelian remain separate from Harga Pokok Pembelian?

criteria.yes: Preserve the client's gross purchase and discount distinction; posting rules may ultimately adjust inventory cost according to policy.
criteria.no: Post both to one HPP family.

cip_core.instructions: Should the existing CIP family return to core?

criteria.yes: The client uses CIP and the asset register shows a substantial project lifecycle; project and site are dimensions.
criteria.no: Keep CIP only as an unsupported legacy hold.

loan_bank_one.instructions: Can current and long-term bank borrowings use one Pinjaman Bank natural account with current/non-current reporting derived from facility maturity schedules?

criteria.yes: Bank/facility identity and maturity belong in loan schedules; financial statements split by due date.
criteria.two: Keep separate current and long-term natural accounts.
criteria.per_bank: Keep one natural account per bank and maturity class.

loan_principal_one.instructions: Can current and long-term formal Principal borrowings use one Pinjaman Principal natural account with maturity schedules?

criteria.yes: Use principal_id/facility/maturity schedule and cost center rather than unit-specific GLs.
criteria.two: Keep current and long-term natural accounts.
criteria.per_unit: Keep one natural account per unit.

other_principal_merge.instructions: Can Hutang Lain-lain Principal by unit merge into Pinjaman Principal?

criteria.conditional: Yes only where counterparty and repayment substance prove it is the same Principal financing; otherwise keep one separate Principal payable nature, never one per unit.
criteria.yes_all: Merge every balance regardless of substance.

principal_cost_center.instructions: Should unit-specific Principal account copies be replaced by cost center/site?

criteria.yes: One proper natural account per substance, with cost center and principal/facility dimensions.

current_noncurrent_schedule.instructions: Is maturity-schedule classification acceptable for both Bank and Principal loans?

criteria.yes: Derive current/non-current presentation from contractual maturity at report date, with reconciliation to GL.
criteria.no: Classification must be permanently encoded only in separate GL accounts.

tax_expense_core.instructions: Should the existing Current Tax Inc/Exp PPh 25 family remain as one core income-tax expense account with cost center?

criteria.retain_normalize: Retain one client-traceable family, preferably normalized as Pajak Penghasilan/Beban Pajak Kini; cost center replaces unit copies.
criteria.remove: Use only tax assets and liabilities with no P&L tax expense.
criteria.per_unit: Keep one tax-expense natural account per unit.

mixed_other_core.instructions: Should Pendapatan (Biaya) Lain-Lain remain one core family as the owner requested?

criteria.retain_controlled: Retain one client family with cost center, restricted reason codes and review so material recurring items are reclassified.
criteria.per_unit: Keep one natural account per unit.

disposed_core.instructions: Should the existing Disposed Inventory family remain in core?

criteria.retain_clearing: Retain as a controlled clearing account tied to disposal documents and expected to clear, with site/reason dimensions.
criteria.remove: Map every disposal directly to loss without a clearing stage.

inventory_damage_core.instructions: Should Biaya Kerusakan Persediaan Barang Dagangan remain one core expense account?

criteria.yes: Retain one natural account; item, cause and site are dimensions/documents.

replacement_count.instructions: What client-traceable core treatment is appropriate for 72 Replacement OE item accounts?

criteria.one_expense: Retain one Biaya Replacement OE family for qualifying expenses; capital replacements go to existing OE asset families; item/site detail stays in register.
criteria.two: Retain one Reserve Replacement OE balance-sheet family and one expense family.
criteria.none: Use existing maintenance/asset families and retire both reserve and replacement families.

land_keep.instructions: Given the owner decision, should the existing land/HGB/land-right and rent families remain available as distinct natures?

criteria.yes: Keep prepaid land rent, HGB/land right cost, accumulated amortization, land-right amortization expense and land rent expense separately; cost center/facility/contract carries identity.
criteria.merge: Merge all into one land account.

preopening_keep.instructions: Should the existing Pre Opening cost, accumulated amortization and amortization expense families remain?

criteria.yes_controlled: Retain the three client families with controlled approval and schedule.
criteria.one: Merge all three statement natures into one account.

giro_delete.instructions: Should Giro Keluar be removed from future posting while Outstanding Giro remains?

criteria.yes: Use Outstanding Giro lifecycle and freeze Giro Keluar legacy history.
criteria.no: Keep both available for future posting.

client_only_result.instructions: Does this corrected design remain compliant with the client-only constraint?

criteria.yes: Every retained core nature maps to a confirmed client family; unit/bank/item/product copies become dimensions or schedules.
criteria.no: It still depends on invented GRNI or other absent families.
